Q5731.reason: The brother’s interest is measured by the uncle’s life and divests the uncle’s life estate if the uncle moves, so it is a shifting executory interest pur autre vie rather than a remainder.

Q5115.reason: At exercise onset glycolysis outruns oxidative clearance, so pyruvate and NADH accumulate and more pyruvate is reduced to lactate.

Q5932.reason: Catecholamines from intense bursts drive hepatic glucose output above muscle uptake, so blood glucose commonly rises about 1–3 mM over 80–90 minutes.
